terms.definition: The green organelle where plants make sugar from sunlight - the site of photosynthesis.
terms.function: Captures light energy and builds sugar from water and carbon dioxide.
terms.whereItIs: In plant cells and some algae.
terms.whyItMatters: It is where plants produce their own food - and the oxygen we breathe.

terms.definition: The green pigment in chloroplasts that captures energy from sunlight.
terms.function: Absorbs light energy to drive photosynthesis.
terms.whereItIs: In the thylakoid membranes of the chloroplast.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the pigment that makes leaves green and starts the food-making process.

terms.definition: A flat membrane disc in the chloroplast; stacks of them are called grana.
terms.function: Provide a large surface where light energy is captured.
terms.whyItMatters: They are the solar panels within the chloroplast.

terms.definition: The fluid space inside the chloroplast around the grana.
terms.function: Where carbon dioxide is built into sugar.
terms.whereItIs: Filling the chloroplast around the stacks.
terms.whyItMatters: The final sugar-making steps happen here.
